title: Cross-region Amazon EventBridge routing
description: Create cross-region event bus routing with Amazon EventBridge

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern shows how to route events in one Region's event bus to an event bus in another region. The template shows how to configure an event rule to send matching events to target event buses in another region. It includes the necessary IAM permissions to allow the rule to invoke the target in another region.

bullets.text: Introducing cross-Region event routing with Amazon EventBridge
Use Amazon EventBridge to Build Decoupled, Event-Driven Architectures

testing.headline: Testing
text: 1. Using curl or Postman, invoke the API Gateway endpoint, using a *region* query parameter to determine where the event should be routed. For example: https://yourendpoint.execute-api.yourregion.amazonaws.com/Prod?region=us-east-1.
2. The event is logged by the Lambda function target in the specified region.
